newsitem.title: USA: Maxco to redeem preferred stock.
newsitem.headline: Maxco to redeem preferred stock.

text.p: Maxco Inc said on Thursday it will redeem outstanding shares of its cumulative, non-voting Series Two preferred stock at face value plus the preferred stock's regular dividend, payable December 31, 1996.
Holders of convertible Series Two preferred stock can convert each preferred share into about 13 shares of common stock until five days before the redemption date, Maxco said.
Maxco also said its board approved giving preferred stock holders two other options for converting preferred shares.
The first would let Series Two share holders convert each preferred share into two shares of a new Series Four preferred stock, which will pay a 10-percent annual dividend.
The second option would let Series Two holders convert each preferred share into a $103 subordinated note bearing 10-percent annual interest.

"By offering additional conversion options, the board believes Maxco can reduce the number of shares used in computing earnings per share by approximately 231,000 shares, which represents approximately six percent of Maxco's outstanding shares," Maxco chairman Max Coon said in a news release.
Maxco's businesses include construction supply units and two plastics-related companies.
